cd probe
logos lint ./inplace
! stderr .
logos lint ./scalarread
! stderr .
logos lint ./nilcheck
! stderr .
! logos lint ./escape
stderr 'escape\.go:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: \[correctness::withlock_leak\]'
! logos lint ./outerindex
stderr 'outerindex\.go:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: \[correctness::withlock_leak\]'

-- probe/go.mod --
module example.com/lockinplace

go 1.27
-- probe/inplace/inplace.go --
package inplace

import "logos/sync"

type State struct { Items []string }

func Use() {
	var lock sync.Locked[State]
	lock.WithLock(func(s *State) {
		s.Items = append(s.Items, "a")
		s.Items[0] = "b"
	})
}
-- probe/scalarread/scalarread.go --
package scalarread

import "logos/sync"

type State struct { Items []string }

func Use() int {
	var lock sync.Locked[State]
	var n, m int
	lock.WithLock(func(s *State) {
		n = len(s.Items)
		m = cap(s.Items)
	})
	return n + m
}
-- probe/nilcheck/nilcheck.go --
package nilcheck

import "logos/sync"

type State struct { Items []string }

func Use() bool {
	var lock sync.Locked[State]
	var ok bool
	lock.WithLock(func(s *State) {
		ok = s.Items != nil
	})
	return ok
}
-- probe/escape/escape.go --
package escape

import "logos/sync"

type State struct { Items []string }

var outer []string

func Use() {
	var lock sync.Locked[State]
	lock.WithLock(func(s *State) {
		outer = s.Items
	})
}
-- probe/outerindex/outerindex.go --
package outerindex

import "logos/sync"

type State struct { Items []string }

var outer [4][]string

func Use() {
	var lock sync.Locked[State]
	lock.WithLock(func(s *State) {
		outer[0] = s.Items
	})
}
